svg.title: Our board liked 12 of these ideas. Kaggle liked 3 of them.
svg.desc: Score change for each idea against the package it was added to. The filled dot is what our board said; the arrow runs to the ring, what Kaggle scored. Orange rows: the board said better, Kaggle said worse. Board deltas compare board runs of the idea and its base (1 to 6 runs each, 50 games unless the tooltip says otherwise). Kaggle deltas are single public scores.
